summary: Explains how the Path Computation Element architecture can serve Abstraction and Control of Traffic-Engineered Networks, a framework for orchestrating virtual networks across large multi-domain networks. It describes how PCE components and the PCE Communication Protocol fit the roles ACTN needs for computing paths.

eli5.summary: A big trip across many countries needs a travel planner who knows the maps. This shows how a path-planning helper can work with a system that controls many networks at once.
